children: Fitch Ratings assigns a deteriorating outlook for North American sovereigns, citing factors including fiscal risks in the U.S. stemming from a divided government and a higher risk of shutdowns. The US administration will likely face additional oversight and scrutiny over its policies, given Democrat majorities in both houses following the recent mid-term election, Fitch adds. Fitch also says the U.S. general government fiscal deficit will remain high at 7.6% of GDP, with general government debt/GDP rising to 121%. While Canada's underlying general government fiscal deficit is expected to remain moderate at around 2% of GDP, gross general government debt/GDP will rise to 93% of GDP, Fitch says.
